title: Comfort Club Member Benefits on Service Calls and the No-Heat and No-Cool Response Guarantee
content:
Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements carry member benefits that apply on a member's repair and emergency service calls. The schedule below lists them for every tier; the service desk applies them on the call's invoice.

## Pricing benefits on a service call

| Tier | Member discount on flat-rate repair parts and labor | Member diagnostic fee (USD) | Discount on the after-hours premium of Evening, Weekend and Overnight Emergency calls | Discount on the after-hours premium of a Holiday Emergency call | Refrigerant added without charge per term (pounds) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 10% | 49.00 | 0% | 0% | 0 |
| Comfort Club Silver | 15% | 0.00 | 0% | 0% | 0 |
| Comfort Club Gold | 15% | 0.00 | 50% | 25% | 0 |
| Comfort Club Platinum | 20% | 0.00 | 100% | 50% | 1 |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 20% | 0.00 | 100% | 100% | 2 |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 25% | 0.00 | 100% | 100% | 2 |

The member diagnostic fee is what a member pays on a service call in place of the call class's standard diagnostic fee.

## Dispatch and response

| Tier | Dispatch queue position | No-heat or no-cool response guarantee (hours from booking to arrival) | Credit when the guarantee is missed (USD per qualifying call) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | Standard | 0 (no guarantee) | 0.00 |
| Comfort Club Silver | Priority | 0 (no guarantee) | 0.00 |
| Comfort Club Gold | Priority | 24 | 25.00 |
| Comfort Club Platinum | Front of line | 12 | 50.00 |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | Front of line | 8 | 50.00 |
| Comfort Club Total Home | Front of line | 8 | 75.00 |

- The **dispatch queue position** is one of three levels: standard, priority or front of line.
- The **response guarantee** is a maximum elapsed number of whole hours from booking to technician arrival on a no-heat or no-cool call; a figure of 0 means the tier carries no response guarantee.
- The **credit** is a dues credit posted per qualifying call when the guarantee is missed.

### Reading across the tiers
- A 100% after-hours premium discount removes the premium entirely; a 50% discount halves it.
- Only Comfort Club Basic charges a member diagnostic fee (49.00); every other tier charges 0.00.
- Comfort Club Platinum is the first tier with a refrigerant allowance (1 pound per term).
